title: natsel team workflow
description: From an idea in the tracker to deleted or merged code

blocks.title: Idea
blocks.description: A product person files it in the tracker

blocks.title: Implement with skills
blocks.description: Skills make the gene and its alleles

blocks.title: Usual checks
blocks.details: Nothing changes in your quality process. One known gap: **combinations** of genes are not tested on stage. It is covered by isolation within a locus and the fast guardrail path.

blocks.title: Gene pool
blocks.description: Control Plane builds species, sets weights
blocks.details: Optional manual control comes as **constraints**: max share, ramp-up, segments, forbidden combinations. Not weight edits, so the statistics stay valid.

blocks.title: Selection on traffic
blocks.description: Each idea's impact is visible, goes to the ticket

blocks.title: Delete or fix
blocks.description: A PR from a skill; a human approves
blocks.details:
- **Extinction**: a losing gene's code is deleted.
- **Fixation**: a winning gene is merged into the base and its flag removed.

New genes come only from people's ideas; the system combines them.
